title: The approximation threshold for metric k-median
summary: For every fixed ε > 0, we give a deterministic polynomial-time $`(1+2/e+\varepsilon)`$-approximation for finite rational metric k -median with specified candidate facilities, opening at most k facilities. Under $`P\ne NP`$, the infimum approximation factor in this model is therefore $`1+2/e`$.
family_title: The metric k -median approximation threshold and recovery

review.reason: Gives a near-optimal approximation algorithm for metric k-median and its hardness threshold.
